description: Search cached real-world weather snapshots and forecasts for planning travel, events, clothing, health, or logistics.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date for the forecast or snapshot lookup.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of forecast days to retrieve.

parameters.name: sensitivity_flags
parameters.description: Weather factors the user cares about, such as heat, rain, wind, UV, humidity, pollen, or air quality.

parameters.name: activity_context
parameters.description: Planned activity affected by weather, such as walking, travel, outdoor event, sports, caregiving, or commute.

parameters.name: risk_tolerance
parameters.description: Tolerance for uncertain or adverse weather.

parameters.name: source_preference
parameters.description: Preferred weather source families, such as Open-Meteo or ETApp WeatherAPI snapshot.
